title: Insight into the sequence-specific elements leading to increased DNA bending and ligase-mediated circularization propensity by antitumor trabectedin.
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子分子动力学模拟研究抗肿瘤药曲贝替定诱导DNA弯曲及环化倾向的序列特异性机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作（T4连接酶）与DNA弯曲建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: DNA curvature is the result of a combination of both intrinsic features of the double helix and external distortions introduced by the environment and the binding of proteins or drugs. The propensity of certain double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) sequences to bend is essential in crucial biological processes, such as replication and transcription, in which proteins are known to either recognize noncanonical DNA conformations or promote their formation upon DNA binding. Trabectedin (Yondelis(R)) is a clinically used antitumor drug which, following covalent bond formation with the 2-amino group of guanine, induces DNA curvature and enhances the circularization ratio, upon DNA ligation, of several dsDNA constructs but not others. By means of unrestrained molecular dynamics simulations using explicitly solvated all-atom models, we rationalize these experimental findings in structural terms and shed light on the crucial, albeit possibly underappreciated, role played by T4 DNA ligase in stabilizing a bent DNA conformation prior to cyclization. Taken together, our results expand our current understanding on how DNA shape modification by trabectedin may affect both the sequence-specific recognition by transcription factors to promoter sites and RNA polymerase II binding.
abstract_zh: DNA弯曲是双螺旋内在特征与环境及蛋白质或药物结合所引入的外部扭曲共同作用的结果。某些双链DNA（dsDNA）序列倾向于弯曲，这在复制和转录等关键生物过程中至关重要，其中已知蛋白质要么识别非经典DNA构象，要么在DNA结合时促进其形成。曲贝替定（Yondelis(R)）是一种临床使用的抗肿瘤药物，在与鸟嘌呤的2-氨基基团形成共价键后，诱导DNA弯曲，并在DNA连接时增强若干dsDNA构建体的环化比率，但对其他构建体无此效应。通过使用显式溶剂化全原子模型进行无约束分子动力学模拟，我们从结构角度合理化了这些实验发现，并阐明了T4 DNA连接酶在环化前稳定弯曲DNA构象中所起的关键作用，尽管这一作用可能未被充分认识。综合来看，我们的结果扩展了当前对曲贝替定诱导的DNA形状修饰如何影响转录因子对启动子位点的序列特异性识别以及RNA聚合酶II结合的理解。
